test_title: PYST 44: SSC GD Constable 2022 - English (Held On : 30 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlying word in the given sentence and complete the sentence.**

In the debate competition he scored less due to his __**banal**__** **arguments, while his opponent won because of his ______ arguments.
solution: The correct answer is **"novel."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Banal"** means not original or interesting. (मौलिक या दिलचस्‍प नहीं; अत्‍यंत साधारण, तुच्‍छ) • **Example**: *It is a **banal**__ comment.* • The sentence mentions that the person's arguments were **banal**, which means they were boring and unoriginal. • The opposite of banal is something that is new and original, which is captured by the word **"novel."** • **"Novel" **means** **new and different. (नया और भिन्‍न) __ • **Example**: *That's a **novel**__ idea.* • The correct answer is Option 3. **Correct sentence**: *In the debate competition he scored less due to his banal arguments, while his opponent won because of his __**novel**__ arguments.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1 (pure): **not mixed with anything else. (शुद्घ (बिना मिलावट का)) • **Option 2 (timid): **easily frightened; shy and nervous. (जल्‍दी डर जाने वाला, भीरु; संकोची और जल्‍दी घबरा जाने वाला) • **Option 4 (weary): **very tired, especially after you have been doing something for a long time. (थका-माँदा (विशेषतः किसी काम को देर तक करते रहने के कारण)) 32:Tc73, The correct answer is **"Filled."**
